mapper.select: SELECT turn_expires_at FROM ai_conversation WHERE id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{actor} AND turn_token=#{turnToken} AND turn_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT id,user_id,idempotency_key,capability_token_hash,conversation_id,turn_token,scope_json,tools_json,status,version,created_at,updated_at FROM ai_run WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

SELECT id,run_id,invocation_key,tool_name,input_fingerprint,status,input_json,output_json,error_code,created_at,completed_at FROM ai_run_invocation WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND invocation_key=#{invocationKey}
